aes256.details: Encrypts 4 KB in CBC mode with tiny-AES-c, key expansion included. Byte table lookups, XORs and shifts over a 16-byte state.

coremark.details: EEMBC's CoreMark®: it searches and sorts a linked list, multiplies small matrices, runs a state machine over input strings and checks every part with a CRC. Most values are 16-bit, with 32-bit sums in the matrix part.

crc16.details: CRC-16/XMODEM computed bit by bit over 4 KB. A 16-bit shift and a conditional XOR for every bit.

crc32.details: CRC-32/BZIP2 computed bit by bit over 4 KB, without a table. A 32-bit shift and a conditional XOR for every bit.

crc8.details: CRC-8/GSM-A computed bit by bit over 4 KB. An 8-bit shift and a conditional XOR for every bit.

dhrystone.details: Reinhold Weicker's synthetic integer benchmark, version 2.1, run 1000 times. Procedure calls, record assignment, string copies and comparisons, and array indexing.

fact.details: Recursive factorials of 0 to 15 in 32-bit arithmetic, eight times over. Call and return overhead and 32-bit multiplication.

pi.details: A spigot algorithm that produces 160 digits of pi, four at a time. Nearly all the time goes into 32-bit multiplication, division and remainder.

puff.details: Mark Adler's puff decompresses a 1.4 KB deflate stream back to 4 KB of text. It reads its input a bit at a time, builds Huffman tables at run time and copies back-references.

sieve.details: The Sieve of Eratosthenes as BYTE magazine published it in 1981, over 4096 byte flags. Tight loops of byte stores with a 16-bit stride.

sieve-bit.details: The same sieve with one bit per odd number, 16000 of them, tested and cleared through small helper functions. Function calls, shifts and bit masks.

stdcbench.details: Philipp Krause's benchmark for small systems. Its c90base module decompresses RLE and Huffman data, sorts sprites by insertion sort and multiplies integer matrices, mostly code taken from real ColecoVision programs.
